metadata.description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 29 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). v0.3 wires the 4 domain agents into SKILL routing and adds the project-level dev-complete checkpoint. v0.4-v0.5 standardize precondition / agent-routing / sub-flag patterns and complete the half-applied deprecations. v0.6 adds a structural pre-flight guard so future half-applied standards auto-fail. v0.7 promotes the guard's Rule 14 + Rule 13-14-footer checks to FAIL-level, adds three new checks (kit_version consistency, template line-caps, hook API version), Rule 16 kit_version read contract (warn-only on future versions), line-level allowlist precision, and an opt-in pre-push hook. Second consecutive ACCURATE release. dev-complete is a release-readiness checkpoint — release and live-ops are out of scope by design.

plugins.name: gamemaker-kit
plugins.description: HTML single-file prototyping + Playwright bot validation (4 procedural personas, suspicious-run extract, trial pruning, CI-aware row evaluation) + asymmetric self-test gate + 6-stage HTML→engine port re-validation + merge gate (asset conflict + gitleaks secret scan) + capture-but-don't-apply regression + project-level dev-complete checkpoint (v0.3). 29 skills (init / roadmap / brainstorm / task-split / status / loop / prototype-rules / shape-advisor / portability-check / mechanic-merge / kill-milestone / mock-inject / design-system / content-plan / prototype / refactor-check / art-spec / art-gen / sound-plan / ux-flow / narrative / save-migrate / validate / self-test / regression / platform-check / merge-gate / port / dev-complete) + 4 domain agents (systems-designer / feel-engineer / economy-balancer / playtest-analyst). v0.3 wires the 4 agents into SKILL routing. v0.4 standardized Rule 13-15 across 27 skills + 7 sub-flag catalogs + 9 deprecated trace fields. v0.5 hotfixed 7 v0.4 regressions. v0.6 adds scripts/check-plugin-meta.sh structural pre-flight (Rule 14 token / endpoint terminology / Rule 13-14 footer) so future half-applied standards auto-fail. v0.7 promotes Rule 14 + Rule 13-14-footer checks to FAIL-level, adds three new checks (D kit_version consistency / E template line-cap / F hook API version), Rule 16 kit_version read contract (warn-only on future-version files, per shape (d)), line-level allowlist precision, and an opt-in scripts/hooks/pre-push hook. Second consecutive ACCURATE release. MAST-aligned safety: one-way log verification via playtest-analyst, no agent-to-agent calls, max-iteration=1. Calibrated for 2D / deterministic input / sessions ≤5min. Zero external accounts, zero API keys.
